'''Qualie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the the [[Galactic War]] she came to [[Voss]], where she asked a Republic individual for assistance in destroying the [[Evuk-Nosk]].<ref name="Better Left Buried" />
